plan: 77.44.6.1.C — desktop panels retain a usable canvas
scope: Prevent opened desktop docks from shrinking or covering the page canvas while retaining all supported dock orders and persisted dock widths where the viewport permits.

implementation.layout: When both desktop docks are open, each grid track is capped by half of (viewport width minus a 400px canvas reserve); existing minimum dock widths remain unchanged.
implementation.reused_project_solution: The existing three-region CSS Grid, dock-width preferences, and six named dock orders; no new panel engine or dependency.
